speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
text: asked the Minister for National Development what is the percentage of the land cost out of the actual cost price for a 3-room, 4-room, and 5-room type Build-To-Order (BTO) flat constructed in 2016 and 2017.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The proportion of land and construction cost for individual projects will vary from project to project, depending on specific site, design and market conditions, as well as other factors affecting land and construction cost.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Just a point of clarification to the Minister.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The Minister mentioned 60% is the average cost borne by HDB, on average, in 2016/2017.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Just to confirm, for land cost, does that mean cost that is paid to the Singapore Land Authority by the HDB?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: We have a robust and transparent process for the purchase of land and also for construction.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: On the construction side, HDB will put up a tender and the tender will set the basis for the construction cost.
